verdict.rationale: Cross-device task handoff is a fair question for a desktop OS, but the evidence shows no paired-device continuity feature in Omarchy. The nearest items are adjacent: a firewall port opened for LocalSend file transfer, resumable Tmux sessions on the same machine, and SSH port forwarding. None of these lets a task started on one paired device be finished on another.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can start a task on one device and finish it on another paired device
